post.description:
Описание метода
Returns [assembly orders](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders) label identifiers and their validation statuses.

You can get the list of label identifiers available for the assembly order via the [list of new assembly orders](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/getV3DbsOrdersNew) method, field `requiredMeta`. post.description:
Описание метода
Returns the statuses of [assembly orders](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders) based on the list of assembly order IDs. `supplierStatus` is a status of an order. The trigger for its change is the action of the seller himself.
Possible values for this field are: | Status | Description | How to move an order to this status | | ------- | --------- | --------------------------------------| | `new` | **New order** | | | `confirm` | **Order on assembly** | [Transfer to assembly](./orders-dbs?locale=ru#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusConfirm) | `deliver` | **Order on delivery**
| [Transfer to delivery](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusDeliver) | `receive` | **Received by the buyer**
| [Notify that the order has been accepted by the buyer](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusReceive)
| `reject` | **Declined upon receipt**
| [Notify that the buyer has declined the order](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusReject) | `cancel` | **Canceled by the seller** | [Cancel the order](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusCancel) | `cancel_missed_call` | **Cancellation due to unreachable buyer**
| The status changes automatically | `wbStatus` is a status of an order on the Wildberries side.
Possible values for this field are: - `waiting` — assembly order in work - `sold` — the buyer got the order - `canceled` — assembly order canceled - `canceled_by_client` — the buyer canceled the order - `declined_by_client` — the buyer canceled the order in the first hour
Cancellation is available to the buyer in the first hour from the moment of order, if the order is not transferred to confirm status. - `defect` — order canceled due to a defect - `ready_for_pickup` — the order arrived the pickup point - `canceled_by_missed_call`— cancellation due to unreachable buyer. For delivery by seller

tags.description:
To access the methods, use a token for the Marketplace category
You can learn how to use methods in business cases in the instructions on working with DBS orders
**How to work:** 1. [Get the new order](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/getV3DbsOrdersNew) and save it until it is ready for assembly. If you do not save the order information in advance, you will only be able to access it after the order is completed (either canceled or sold). Check the [delivery date and time](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersDeliveryDate). 2. [Transfer it for assembly](./orders-dbs?locale=ru#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusConfirm). 3. [Transfer to delivery](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusDeliver). 4. After the order is transferred to assembly, [buyer information](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersClient) (name, phone) becomes available. 5. After delivering the task to the buyer, you need to notify our server that the [order was accepted](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusReceive) by the buyer or that the [buyer declined the order](./orders-dbs#tag/dbsAssemblyOrders/operation/postV3DbsOrdersStatusReject).
tags.name: dbsAssemblyOrders
